extraPrompt: Generate a comprehensive test suite for the PD_* I2C driver (AS7341) on STM32WB0x. Provide host Unity/CMock tests with a mocked I2C layer covering: I2C read/write correctness, ACK/NACK handling, LED On/Off state, data-path conversions and data-ready signaling, and error paths (timeouts, bus errors) including recovery. Include reset defaults. Add on-target UART-harness tests for readiness, ID, thresholds, interrupts, and measurements. Target ≥90% unit coverage, deterministic test vectors, versioned data, and CI with OpenOCD/pyOCD producing JUnit XML.
